en.title: Home Alone Sequel Officially in Development With Macaulay Culkin, Seth Rogen
en.summary: A beloved holiday classic is making a comeback. Disney is developing a new Home Alone film, bringing back original star Macaulay Culkin alongside Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg.
en.body:
Get ready to dust off those holiday decorations, because a brand new *Home Alone* adventure is officially in the works at Disney. In an exciting development for fans worldwide, original star **Macaulay Culkin** is set to reprise his iconic role as Kevin McCallister. Joining him behind the scenes are comedy powerhouses **Seth Rogen** and **Evan Goldberg**, who are shaping the script and will produce the sequel through their Point Grey banner.

Details about the plot and further casting remain under wraps, leaving us to speculate on the next chapter for the resourceful McCallister. While the original films saw a young Kevin defending his home from bumbling burglars, Culkin himself reportedly pitched an idea in 2025 envisioning Kevin as a father, possibly widowed or divorced, navigating parenthood and perhaps another holiday home invasion. This suggests a more mature, adult Kevin facing new, perhaps more complex, challenges. The franchise, a cornerstone of 20th Century Studios' success, has already proven its enduring appeal, with the first two **Chris Columbus**-directed films grossing over $836 million worldwide. The prospect of Rogen and Goldberg, known for their sharp, often irreverent comedic sensibilities in films like *Superbad* and *Pineapple Express*, tackling this beloved property is certainly a conversation starter.

## A New Chapter for Kevin McCallister

The announcement has sent ripples of excitement through the fanbase, eager to see how the *Home Alone* formula will be updated for a new generation. The involvement of both **Macaulay Culkin** and the creative team behind some of the most successful comedies of the past two decades suggests a commitment to honoring the spirit of the original while injecting fresh energy. For many, the idea of seeing an adult Kevin McCallister, perhaps grappling with his own family dynamics, is a compelling prospect. The franchise’s legacy as a holiday staple means any new installment carries significant weight, aiming to capture the magic that made the first film a global phenomenon while appealing to contemporary audiences. The success of the original films, particularly their massive box office returns, underscores the significant commercial and cultural footprint of the *Home Alone* brand.

## What to Expect Next

While plot specifics and casting beyond **Macaulay Culkin** are still unknown, the project is in its early stages of development. Before diving fully into the world of Kevin McCallister, **Seth Rogen** and **Evan Goldberg** are expected to wrap up preparations for their original horror-comedy film for Universal. Fans will be eagerly awaiting further announcements regarding the production timeline and creative direction for this much-anticipated sequel.

content_raw: Culkin is expected to reprise his role as Kevin McCallister, while Rogen and Goldberg are writing and producing the sequel.
